theorems.name: Submission.dtc_blowUp_preimage
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (S' : GeometricCurrentOn (dilation x lam '' U) n), ∃ S'' : GeometricCurrentOn U n, blowUp S'' x lam hlam.ne' = S' ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity S' → IsIntegerMultiplicity S'')
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
